title: WhenMounted and BigInt Props in Inertia.js v3.8
content:
Inertia.js v3.8 adds a WhenMounted component for browser-only code under SSR, BigInt support for large integer props, Form callback fixes, and more.

The post WhenMounted and BigInt Props in Inertia.js v3.8 appeared first on Laravel News.
